verdict.rationale: Zero documents a ZeroMCP server exposing email actions (labels, search, compose, delete, drafts, web search via Perplexity) with auth via session token/OAuth, giving AI-native users a documented API surface. However this is an MCP interface, not a general public REST/GraphQL API, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation it works as documented. missing for 10: a general-purpose public API (REST/GraphQL) beyond MCP, independent verification of MCP functionality, and rate-limit/auth details beyond session token.
